guide.text: Olá! I'm {name}. Welcome to the Amazon. These rivers are my home, and I know them well. Where are you headed, traveler?
guide.action: extends a weathered hand in greeting

trader.text: Ah, a customer! I'm {name}, and I have what you need. Supplies? Information? Both come at a price in these parts.
trader.action: gestures to an array of goods on the riverbank

shaman.text: The spirits told me you would come, {playerName}. I am {name}. You seek something precious, yes? The forest keeps many secrets.

hunter.text: You're far from civilization, friend. I'm {name}. If you're looking for game or safe passage, I might be able to help.

herbalist.text: Ah, another soul seeking the forest's gifts. I'm {name}. Perhaps I have what you're looking for... if you know what to ask for.

elder.text: Come, sit. I am {name}, and I have seen many seasons pass. Your grandmother spoke of you often. What brings you to these waters?
elder.action: gestures to a seat by the fire

default.text: Olá! I'm {name}. Welcome to this place. What brings you to the Amazon?
{name} considers your words carefully before responding. 'I see. Well, the path ahead isn't easy, but I wish you luck.'

helpful.text: {name} smiles warmly. 'I can help you with that. Let me share what I know.'

suspicious.text: {name} narrows their eyes. 'Why should I trust you with that information?'

farewell.text: {name} bids you farewell. 'Safe travels, friend. May the river guide you well.'

polite.text: Thank you for your time. I appreciate your help.
I should be going now. Thank you.

direct.text: I need information about the area.

friendly.text: I'm searching for something important to me.
